units.source_text: 我们两人脊梁发硬，看得人神了。

en.t: The two of us sat stiff-backed, staring as if entranced.

units.source_text: 后来我们按顺序回忆，觉得可能是怀了上官的孩子的女子，

en.t: Later, when we recalled it in order, we thought it was probably a woman carrying her superior officer's child,

units.source_text: 与出征的士官举行诀别仪式吧。

en.t: performing a farewell ritual with the officer who was going off to war.

units.source_text: 然而，这时候的感动，拒绝了做出任何的解释。

en.t: Yet the emotion of that moment refused to accept any explanation at all.

units.source_text: 由于过分注意，反而看不见，

en.t: Because we were watching too intently, we instead could no longer see clearly,

units.source_text: 过了很久，待意识清醒过来时，

en.t: and after a long while, when our awareness finally returned,

units.source_text: 才发现这对男女不知什么时候从客厅消失了，

en.t: we discovered that the man and woman had somehow disappeared from the parlor,

units.source_text: 剩下的只是一块宽阔的绯扛地毯。

en.t: leaving behind only a broad scarlet carpet.
